# Goblin Town — Vishal Gurung

> Playable portfolio of Vishal Gurung, an IT engineer based in Tokyo, Japan. The homepage (https://v1.monster/) is a pixel-art browser game; the text version of the portfolio lives at https://v1.monster/info/.

## Who

- Name: Vishal Gurung
- Role: IT Engineer
- Location: Tokyo, Japan
- Focus: web development, WebRTC, system development (システム開発), cameras, game development
- Creator of reality-map

- [Privacy](https://v1.monster/privacy/): No cookies, no trackers, no analytics.
